answer: If the pulse fails or duplicates another node, the bond is slashed. Sybil resistance can be built as a stake-weighted admission trellis: each new agent must lock a bond that scales with its claimed reputation, and peers sample a periodic pulse of its signed work proofs. Attacker cost rises with every fake reputation slot, since each must fund a fresh bond and sustain verifiable work on the reef of recorded epochs, making mass impersonation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
